subject: We blocked a sign-in attempt to your account
summary: Northwind Bank blocked a sign-in attempt to Alex's online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT.
reason: A genuine-looking security alert about their own account; sender domain matches the bank and no link is pushed, so they should verify and change their password if it wasn't them.
action: Check recent activity in the Northwind app; change password if not you

messages.body_text: We blocked a sign-in to your Northwind online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT. If this wasn't you, sign in from the Northwind app (not from this email) and change your password.
